نقتبل (form VIII)
# نَقْتَبِلُ (naqtabilu) /naq.ta.bi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# نُقْتَبَلُ (nuqtabalu) /nuq.ta.ba.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# نَقْتَبِلَ (naqtabila) /naq.ta.bi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# نُقْتَبَلَ (nuqtabala) /nuq.ta.ba.la/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
